definition:
The celestial sphere is **an abstract and imaginary sphere** of infinite radius centered on Earth or an observer, onto which all stars, planets, and sky objects appear **projected**. 

 A “point” on the celestial sphere represents the **directions** of celestial objects in the sky. That is to say, any star in come specific direction, occupies a fixed point on the celestial sphere.
misconceptions: The celestial sphere is not a physical shell.
Stars represented on it are not equally distant from Earth.
takeaway: A map of directions, not of distances.

source.section: Looking Out from a Spinning, Round Earth
